destination.title: Quintessence dynamics, couplings and microscopic consistency
destination.question: How can quintessence models produce cosmological evolution while controlling their interactions, quantum corrections and source-specific consistency requirements?
destination.summary: No original verbal region definition was supplied, so its numerical membership cannot certify a scientific scope. This proposed family accommodates different gravitational frameworks, dimensions, epochs and observables. It retains adjacent bounce and uplifting questions without treating them as established quintessence realizations.

systems: Canonical and other source-specified quintessence models
Moduli, radion, axion and flux-monodromy candidates
Higgs, symmetry-breaking scalar and QCD sectors interacting with quintessence
targets: Background evolution and source-dated observational tests
Matter couplings, varying parameters and gravity tests
Microscopic construction and dynamical slowing mechanisms
regimes: Late acceleration, radiation and matter domination
Inflation, reheating and thermal evolution where explicitly considered
Source-specific effective theories and compactification dimensions
assumptions: Conjectural potential restrictions apply only to the questions that explicitly test them.
Light-field protection, suppression of matter couplings and viable initial conditions require separate assessment.
Numerical proximity and shared terminology do not establish question equivalence.
conventions: Keep gravitational frames, scalar normalization and equation-of-state definitions source-specific.
Distinguish effective dark-energy phantom behavior from the scalar equation of state and from NEC-violating bounce matter.
includes: Negative results, open constructions and historical observational inputs
Methodological settings with their own source-scoped identities
excludes: A universal four-dimensional, minimally coupled or canonical premise
An inference that any conjecture or proposed construction is established
Quintom bouncing as a core quintessence question
Current observational validation inferred from archived results

sources.title: Time variation of fundamental couplings and dynamical dark energy

evidence.text: How can correlated variations of fundamental couplings, cosmological scalar dynamics and weak equivalence principle tests constrain one another, and which illustrative quintessence histories accommodate the historical variation claims and bounds?

sources.title: Natural Quintessence in String Theory

evidence.text: Can a geometric scalar in a string compactification provide quintessence with a radiatively stable mass near 10^-33 eV and sufficiently weak Standard Model couplings, and produce viable late-time evolution with or without dark matter interactions?

sources.title: Quintessence: A Review

evidence.text: How do canonical quintessence models evolve, which analytic descriptions of their equation of state and matter growth are useful observationally, and what particle-physics mechanisms can protect the required tiny scalar mass?

sources.title: de Sitter swampland conjecture and the Higgs potential

evidence.text: Can a quintessence gradient grow with the electroweak potential away from the observed Higgs vacuum while avoiding direct couplings to other visible matter?

sources.title: de Sitter swampland conjecture and the Higgs potential

evidence.text: Can a four-dimensional Standard Model–quintessence theory obey an order-one scalar-potential gradient bound while satisfying limits on fifth forces and varying Standard Model parameters? Can a controlled string construction realize the required selective couplings?

sources.title: The Swampland, Quintessence and the Vacuum Energy

evidence.text: Can cosmological variation of particle masses or couplings coexist with a quintessence potential of dark-energy size once quantum vacuum-energy corrections are included?

sources.title: The dS swampland conjecture with the electroweak symmetry and QCD chiral symmetry breaking

evidence.text: How can general nonderivative interactions between quintessence and the Standard Model be parametrized while keeping the gravitational frame and scalar normalization explicit?

sources.title: Strongly Coupled Quintessence

evidence.text: Can strongly coupled flux-monodromy effective theories realize technically natural quintessence with sufficiently small potential slope, controlled quantum corrections and observable departures from a cosmological constant?

sources.title: The swampland conjecture and the Higgs expectation value

evidence.text: Can the Higgs mass and quartic terms track a quintessence-dependent vacuum-energy counterterm closely enough to retain small energy as the field evolves?

sources.title: Quantum Fine-Tuning in Stringy Quintessence Models

evidence.text: Can low-scale new physics, a persistent cancellation, or environmental screening reconcile a radiatively stable quintessence slope with gravity tests? The paper leaves these as open routes after identifying two obstacles.

sources.title: Quantum Fine-Tuning in Stringy Quintessence Models

evidence.text: Can coupling quintessence only to hidden matter avoid visible fifth forces without losing the natural potential–slope relation? The visible Standard Model remains a spectator for the slope but contributes to the total vacuum energy.

sources.title: Quantum Fine-Tuning in Stringy Quintessence Models

evidence.text: Does a small quintessence vacuum energy automatically imply a sufficiently small slope after radiative corrections, or must the two quantities be adjusted independently? The target also includes consistency with fifth-force observations.

sources.title: The $F$-term Problem and other Challenges of Stringy Quintessence

evidence.text: The required mass spectrum separates a Hubble-scale rolling scalar from gravitationally coupled moduli and extra-dimensional excitations, while keeping SM superpartners above collider limits. These simultaneous requirements, rather than quintessence flatness alone, drive the obstruction.

sources.title: The $F$-term Problem and other Challenges of Stringy Quintessence

evidence.text: What prevents a tiny change of a large supersymmetry-breaking contribution from raising a tuned quintessence potential into a positive, excessively flat regime? The question concerns correlations among microscopic parameters and the response of stabilized fields.

sources.title: QCD, Flavor, and the de Sitter Swampland

evidence.text: Can coupling quintessence to QCD separate the evolution of a metastable valley from that of the QCD ground-state valley enough to satisfy the SdSC without an immediate ground-state crunch?

sources.title: Swampland Conjectures and Cosmological Expansion

evidence.text: How does a canonical homogeneous quintessence field evolve in an expanding universe containing matter? The setting provides the scalar stress tensor and background gravitational equations needed to translate potential constraints into field motion.

sources.title: Gravitational Wave Signatures from Warm Dark Energy

evidence.text: Can gauge interactions slow a quintessence axion on a steep potential while producing observable gravitational waves during matter domination? The paper compares an Abelian particle-production mechanism with a non-Abelian classical-background mechanism.

sources.title: Cosmological observations in scalar - tensor quintessence

evidence.text: How should supernova distances, cosmological perturbations, CMB anisotropies and matter spectra be interpreted when a single quintessence field also changes the gravitational coupling, subject to local-gravity and nucleosynthesis constraints?

sources.title: Natural quintessence and large extra dimensions

evidence.text: Can the radion of a large-extra-dimension brane model supply technically natural quintessence while satisfying bounds on long-range scalar forces and gravitational-coupling evolution from nucleosynthesis onward?

sources.title: Quintessence and the rest of the world

evidence.text: Can a symmetry suppress observable couplings between a nearly massless quintessence field and ordinary matter while retaining a detectable electromagnetic polarization-rotation signal?

sources.title: Extended quintessence

evidence.text: Can one non-minimally coupled scalar provide present quintessence and a varying gravitational coupling while satisfying local gravity bounds, and what signatures does this produce in linear CMB and matter perturbations?

sources.title: Quantum corrections in quintessence models

evidence.text: How do quantum fluctuations from massive matter, quintessence self-interactions, and curved-background couplings affect the flatness, cosmological evolution, and gravitational description of a rolling quintessence field?

sources.title: Forays into the dark side of the swamp

evidence.text: How much can canonical exponential quintessence move over cosmological time, and can that motion generate the parameter changes required by the particle-physics examples?

sources.title: Time variation of fundamental couplings and dynamical dark energy

evidence.text: Expand coupling functions as Δln Gk ≈ βk Δϕ. Differentiate atomic masses to obtain scalar charges and η ≈ 2λs(λb−λc), retaining isospin, Coulomb binding and strong nuclear surface contributions.

sources.title: Natural Quintessence in String Theory

evidence.text: Use an autonomous phase-plane system, analytical instantaneous fixed points, and numerical trajectories to study the poly-instanton plateau and loop-dominated region separately and in the full potential.

sources.title: Quintessence: A Review

evidence.text: For linear matter growth, expand w and the growth index in Ωφ, approximate the index as nearly constant, integrate the density contrast, and express the result as f(z)σ8(z) for comparison with redshift-space distortions.

sources.title: de Sitter swampland conjecture and the Higgs potential

evidence.text: Select a stationary sector configuration, keep the remaining fields at specified values, evaluate the complete gradient norm, and divide by the complete potential. Apply the resulting local ratio to a conjecture that quantifies over field space.

sources.title: The Swampland, Quintessence and the Vacuum Energy

evidence.text: Compare the loop-potential change across a scalar interval with the allowed dark-energy density. Estimate coupling derivatives using loop-factor counting and distinguish absolute from relative changes.

sources.title: The dS swampland conjecture with the electroweak symmetry and QCD chiral symmetry breaking

evidence.text: Solve the sourced scalar's stationarity equation before applying the gradient conjecture. This avoids counting a removable tadpole as an independent gradient, provided the shifted branch exists, is stable and admits a controlled local expansion.

sources.title: Moduli evolution in the presence of matter fields and flux compactification

evidence.text: The model couples the modulus controlling a runaway direction to a dynamical hidden matter sector that also participates in vacuum uplifting. It permits the cosmological role of the uplifting field to be studied instead of replacing that field by a fixed positive contribution.

sources.title: Two-Field quintessential Higgs Inflation

evidence.text: Can quintessence evolution increase the early effective Higgs self-coupling enough to prevent electroweak-vacuum instability?

sources.title: The Landscape, the Swampland and the Era of Precision Cosmology

evidence.text: What protects the small quintessence potential and gradient from quantum corrections, and can a conjectural lower gradient bound explain their tuning?

sources.title: Spherical collapse in quintessence models with zero speed of sound

evidence.text: How does single-scalar quintessence with negligible sound speed alter spherical collapse, the linear collapse threshold and halo abundance, including the quintessence contribution to the gravitational mass of virialized objects?

sources.title: Quantum Fine-Tuning in Stringy Quintessence Models

evidence.text: Does the protection survive when quintessence itself propagates in a loop? A linear matter potential makes that failure accessible at one loop, while the source places the analogous massive quadratic-matter corrections at two loops.

sources.title: Quintessence, flat potential and string / M theory axion

evidence.text: Can quintessence retain an extremely flat potential despite matter and quantum-gravity effects, and can heterotic M-theory or Type I axions realize it with viable cosmological initial conditions?

sources.title: Constraints on quintessence scalar field models using cosmological observations

evidence.text: Can selected quintessence potentials explain late cosmic acceleration, have their shape parameters constrained by cosmological observations, relieve the H0 tension, and compete statistically with ΛCDM?

sources.title: Quintessence Saves Higgs Instability

evidence.text: Can a cosmologically evolving quintessence prefactor raise the early Higgs quartic enough to eliminate inflationary vacuum instability? The paper seeks a lower bound on the exponential slope ξ and compares it with dark-energy constraints.

sources.title: Leaving the Swampland: Non-geometric fluxes and the Distance Conjecture

evidence.text: Can an inverse-volume runaway serve as quintessence while suppressing changes in matter couplings? The source offers a qualitative possibility without calculating cosmological dynamics or fifth-force observables.

sources.title: Building Supergravity Quintessence Model

evidence.text: Sequestering tests whether a special gravitational geometry can prevent hidden-sector supersymmetry breaking from giving quintessence a large mass, without imposing the imaginary-field shift symmetry used in the first construction.

sources.title: Two-Field quintessential Higgs Inflation

evidence.text: Can coupling quintessence to the entire Higgs potential avoid the extremely small gradient ratio of an additive construction near the Higgs maximum?

sources.title: Phantom matters

evidence.text: Can coupling canonical quintessence to matter, and possibly radiation, produce an effective phantom dark-energy regime while accommodating steep string-inspired potentials? What determine effective equation-of-state poles and the early dark-energy-like feature in these solutions?

sources.title: The dS swampland conjecture with the electroweak symmetry and QCD chiral symmetry breaking

evidence.text: How large can the de Sitter gradient constant c be when quintessence couples to the Standard Model and is evaluated at pion or Higgs positive-energy extrema? Can an additional scalar direction remove the observational obstruction?

sources.title: Forays into the dark side of the swamp

evidence.text: Can quintessence move during radiation domination while contributing only a small fraction of the cosmic density?

sources.title: Isocurvature Perturbations of Dark Energy and Dark Matter from the Swampland Conjecture

evidence.text: Can quintessence retain the small mass required for inflationary fluctuations despite gravitational, inflaton, and thermal couplings?

sources.title: Interacting quintessence from a variational approach Part II: derivative couplings

evidence.text: Can a variational coupling linear in the scalar-field gradient produce covariant interacting quintessence models with matter-dominated intermediate evolution, late acceleration, and possible phantom-barrier crossing?

sources.title: Dark Energy and the Refined de Sitter Conjecture

evidence.text: Can a scalar potential with spontaneous symmetry breaking satisfy the refined conjecture without coupling that scalar directly to quintessence? The test model combines a quartic h potential with an independent exponential φ potential.

sources.title: The Limits of quintessence

evidence.text: Can simple canonical quintessence models be classified by their equation-of-state dynamics, and what observational precision and microphysical restrictions could distinguish them from one another or from a cosmological constant?

sources.title: A stringy perspective on the coincidence problem

evidence.text: Can production of descending tower states alter quintessence materially, beyond merely invalidating their integration out?

sources.title: Forays into the dark side of the swamp

evidence.text: How does an optional coupling of rolling quintessence to the Higgs potential affect thermal restoration and vacuum stability?

sources.title: Quintessence Axion Revisited in Light of Swampland Conjectures

evidence.text: Can the physical electroweak theta angle become a quintessence field? The proposal replaces the fixed angle by a/f_a and restricts other interactions so that electroweak instantons can set the small potential amplitude.

sources.title: Quintessential difficulties

evidence.text: Can observationally significant, slowly rolling quintessence be obtained without extreme tuning once additional potential terms, radiative corrections and supersymmetry breaking are included?

sources.title: QCD, Flavor, and the de Sitter Swampland

evidence.text: Can a proposed quintessence escape satisfy the conjecture in a metastable QCD sector while allowing a universe in the QCD ground state to persist? The comparison fixes the Standard Model parameters across sectors.

sources.title: Reconstructing Quintessence

evidence.text: Canonical quintessence replaces a constant dark-energy density with a minimally coupled scalar whose kinetic and potential energies determine cosmic expansion. A potential alone does not determine the history; scalar boundary conditions are also needed.

sources.title: The Landscape, the Swampland and the Era of Precision Cosmology

evidence.text: Can the reported string construction supply an exponential slope small enough for quintessence? Its small-slope regime requires at least 11542 internal dimensions.

sources.title: QCD, Flavor, and the de Sitter Swampland

evidence.text: Can a conjectured restriction on the total scalar potential constrain quark masses and the QCD angle through composite pion vacua? The paper also asks whether quintessence removes this proposed connection between quantum gravity and flavor.

destination.title: String construction, supersymmetry breaking and stability
destination.question: How do string constructions realize or break supersymmetry, and which spectral, dynamical and consistency tests constrain their vacuum energy and stability?
destination.summary: The original packet supplies candidate memberships without an independently stated scientific region scope. Its connections are useful for retrieval, but neither nonsupersymmetry nor vacuum instability applies uniformly. The proposed organization separates construction, radiative effects, decay, consistency tests and neighboring applications; it remains a proposal requiring independent review.

systems: Heterotic, type I and type II constructions
Open and unoriented strings, D-branes and orientifolds
Closed-string backgrounds and their effective descriptions
Noncritical heterotic backgrounds as a qualified neighboring regime
targets: Supersymmetry-breaking spectra and restricted scalar content
Vacuum energy, tadpoles and moduli dynamics
Open- and closed-string instabilities and decay
Gauge thresholds, effective descriptions and duality limits
regimes: Tree-level, loop-corrected, classical and proposed nonperturbative analyses kept distinct
Supersymmetric comparisons and constructions with broken or absent spacetime supersymmetry
assumptions: No common dimension, supersymmetry status, coupling regime or loop order is imposed on the family
Numerical membership and source-object graph relations do not establish physical premises
conventions: Worldsheet supersymmetry is distinguished from spacetime supersymmetry
R-R tadpole constraints are distinguished from NS-NS or gravitational tadpoles
Tree-level tachyon freedom is distinguished from quantum and nonperturbative stability
Off-shell worldsheet RG flow is distinguished from on-shell time evolution
includes: Ordinary and pre-Swampland construction and consistency work
Qualified method bridges and supersymmetric comparisons
Separate source-scoped access to compound questions
excludes: Treating all numerical members as equivalent questions
Treating IKKT dimensional emergence or a Higgs phase of gravity as established vacuum-stability subcases
Interpreting gauge-derived global-charge breaking as supersymmetry breaking

sources.title: Nonperturbative Instability of AdS(5) x S**5/Z(k)

evidence.text: Does the freely acting, nonsupersymmetric AdS₅×S⁵/Z_k orbifold remain nonperturbatively unstable when large coupling removes its closed-string tachyons, and what does the decay imply for its strongly coupled gauge-theory interpretation?

sources.title: Tadpole Resummations in String Theory

evidence.text: Can summing closed-string tree diagrams with NS–NS tadpoles recover physical vacuum energies when calculations start from a background that fails the field equations? The paper tests a boundary-state prescription against bosonic tachyon condensation and orientifold examples.

sources.title: Towards a nonsupersymmetric string phenomenology

evidence.text: Can tachyon-free, intrinsically nonsupersymmetric heterotic strings suppress dilaton-tadpole instabilities while retaining low-energy spectra resembling the Standard Model or unified extensions?

sources.title: Chiral Heterotic Strings with Positive Cosmological Constant

evidence.text: Can chiral heterotic models with spontaneous N=1→0 supersymmetry breaking develop a positive, exponentially suppressed one-loop potential that drives the breaking scale below the string scale, and which spectral conditions govern this behavior?

sources.title: Stability and vacuum energy in open string models with broken supersymmetry

evidence.text: Can Scherk–Schwarz compactifications of open string theory have exponentially suppressed or positive one-loop vacuum energy without developing tachyonic Wilson-line moduli?

sources.title: Stability and vacuum energy in open string models with broken supersymmetry

evidence.text: How do orientifold-compatible brane positions determine the massless spectrum and one-loop vacuum energy after supersymmetry is broken along a circle? The T-dual description makes Wilson lines geometric and separates endpoint half-branes from mirror-paired stacks.

sources.title: String Phenomenology From a Worldsheet Perspective

evidence.text: Can a worldsheet construction produce phenomenologically useful non-supersymmetric vacua, and how can their low-energy EFT descriptions be recovered? The paper explores tachyon projection and relations between worldsheet supersymmetry classes as two approaches.

sources.title: On String Vacua without Supersymmetry: brane dynamics, bubbles and holography

evidence.text: How do gravitational tadpoles affect classical and quantum stability in tachyon-free strings without supersymmetry, and can brane dynamics and holography explain the resulting instabilities?

sources.title: Geometry of orientifold vacua and supersymmetry breaking

evidence.text: Can perturbative orientifolds realize brane supersymmetry breaking without NS-NS disk tadpoles or open-string instabilities, while separating open-sector breaking from gravitino masses and testing the proposed obstruction to massless gravitinos?

sources.title: Supersymmetry breaking and stability in string vacua: Brane dynamics, bubbles and the swampland

evidence.text: How do gravitational tadpoles from string-scale supersymmetry breaking affect vacuum solutions, classical and quantum stability, and their interpretation through brane dynamics and swampland conjectures?

sources.title: Rigid vacua with Brane Supersymmetry Breaking

evidence.text: Can local, nontrivial cancellation of twisted R-R charges produce BSB orientifolds with fewer brane deformation moduli, and how should their gauge kinetic functions and string-defect unitarity constraints be formulated?

sources.title: New Nonsupersymmetric Tachyon-Free Strings

evidence.text: Can heterotic asymmetric orbifolds provide new lower-dimensional analogues of the O(16)×O(16) string: nonsupersymmetric, tree-level tachyon-free models with only the string coupling as a neutral scalar, chiral matter and positive leading vacuum energy?

sources.title: Aspects of Stability, Rigidity and Unitarity in String Vacua

evidence.text: How do high-mass spectral cancellations diagnose tree-level tachyons, how do tadpole constraints produce rigid six-dimensional orientifolds, and what additional consistency conditions follow from defect unitarity and Dai–Freed anomalies?

sources.title: Twisted orientifold planes and S-duality without supersymmetry

evidence.text: Can a nine-dimensional orientifold without background open strings break supersymmetry by compactification, remain continuously connected to type IIB, and admit a nonperturbative S-duality interpretation?

sources.title: Aspects of strings without spacetime supersymmetry

evidence.text: How do tachyons and scalar tadpoles obstruct stable string vacua without spacetime supersymmetry, and what can worldsheet diagnostics, off-shell formulations and gravitational background shifts establish?

sources.title: The cosmological constant and dark dimensions from non-supersymmetric strings

evidence.text: Can non-supersymmetric strings cancel gauge/matter one-loop vacuum energy despite string-scale brane supersymmetry breaking, while bulk contributions track large extra dimensions and moduli dynamics generate a dark-energy scale?

sources.title: Strings on freely acting orbifolds: Spectra, moduli spaces and branes

evidence.text: How do freely acting, especially asymmetric, type II orbifolds realize spontaneous supersymmetry breaking, constrained moduli spaces and consistent brane spectra, and what do their infinite-distance limits imply for swampland conjectures?

sources.title: Asymmetric orbifolds, noncommutative geometry and type I string vacua

evidence.text: How do asymmetric rotations act on D-branes and implement asymmetric orbifold symmetries in the open-string sector? Can this explain mixed boundary conditions, recover boundary noncommutativity, and construct tadpole-cancelled asymmetric type I vacua?

sources.title: Mirror symmetry and closed string tachyon condensation

evidence.text: What do protected N=2 worldsheet RG flows and mirror symmetry imply about closed-string tachyon condensation in compact and noncompact backgrounds, and what probe-theory dualities might follow?

sources.title: Tachyon dynamics in open string theory

evidence.text: How does open-string tachyon condensation resolve unstable D-branes: what replaces the unstable vacuum, how do lower-dimensional branes emerge, and what does rolling tachyon dynamics imply about closed-string decay and open-string completeness?

sources.title: Anomaly free nonsupersymmetric large N gauge theories from orientifolds

evidence.text: Can supersymmetry-breaking modifications of perturbative Type IIB orientifolds produce anomaly-free, nonchiral and chiral large-N gauge theories with cancelled massless and tachyonic tadpoles, and inherit correlation-function reduction to a parent N=4 theory?

sources.title: Anomaly cancellations in type I D-9 - anti-D-9 system and the USp(32) string theory

evidence.text: Which massless spectra, anomaly cancellations and R-R tadpole conditions make ten-dimensional D9–anti-D9 systems consistent, and does a symplectic orientifold projection yield a tachyon-free nonsupersymmetric USp(32) endpoint?

sources.title: Nonperturbative Instability of AdS(5) x S**5/Z(k)

evidence.text: Numerically integrates outward from the near-D3 expansion, adjusting two parameters to suppress the two growing asymptotic modes. The radial gauge is g(r)=R²ρ(r); continuation from known large-k matching data is used to approach k=3.

sources.title: Tadpole Resummations in String Theory

evidence.text: Represent D-branes by coherent closed-string boundary states and orientifold planes by crosscap states. Their overlaps with a closed-string propagator encode cylinder, Möbius-strip and Klein-bottle amplitudes; low-energy Einstein-frame brane couplings fix the tadpole normalization and motivate contact vertices.

sources.title: Towards a nonsupersymmetric string phenomenology

evidence.text: Vacuum energies are modular integrals of the one-loop partition function. Theta-function modular transformations resum momentum sums for large-radius asymptotics. The authors report checking their models through partition functions, Poisson-resummed expansions, and explicit low-lying spectra.

sources.title: Chiral Heterotic Strings with Positive Cosmological Constant

evidence.text: Expand Z in qᵣ=e^(−2πτ₂) and qᵢ=e^(2πiτ₁). Split the fundamental domain into rectangular τ₂>1 and curved τ₂<1 regions; only the latter retains non-level-matched terms. Equation (5.15) expresses fermionic-point positivity as a weighted sum of spectral coefficients and model-independent integrals.

sources.title: Stability and vacuum energy in open string models with broken supersymmetry

evidence.text: Expose modular invariance in a Lagrangian lattice, unfold wrapping orbits, impose level matching by strip integration, and resum the Scherk–Schwarz momentum. The sequence distinguishes a physical light closed-string tower from non-level-matched terms in the original integrand.

sources.title: String Phenomenology From a Worldsheet Perspective

evidence.text: Fix the basis, enumerate allowed phase assignments, construct sectors and apply their projections. Classify the resulting spectra by gauge group, chirality and unwanted states. In this paper, the operation is proposed for searches extending beyond the displayed six- and three-generation examples.

sources.title: Non-supersymmetric D1/D5, F/NS5 and closed string tachyon condensation

evidence.text: Can non-supersymmetric D1/D5 and F/NS5 supergravity families interpolate between black configurations and KK bubbles, and under what stability and validity conditions can these interpolations model closed-string tachyon condensation?

sources.title: The Octagon at large M

evidence.text: The Octagon quiver provides the ultraviolet string construction whose cascade must end in a viable supersymmetry-breaking theory. Fractional-brane and orientifold rank shifts overlap on some faces but differ on face 2, a distinction used in the proposed bulk interpretation.

sources.title: Some properties of open string theories

evidence.text: How can suitable oriented closed-string spectra generate consistent open descendants, and how do crosscap projections, boundary factorization and tadpole conditions determine their Chan–Paton symmetry and anomaly constraints?

sources.title: Modular invariance, misalignment and finiteness in non-supersymmetric strings

evidence.text: How do cancellations in sector-averaged string degeneracies become cancellations in the physical one-loop cosmological constant, and what additional modular structure removes the remaining power-law divergences?

sources.title: Tachyon condensation on the brane anti-brane system

evidence.text: Does the negative tachyon potential energy at its classical minimum exactly cancel the tensions of a coincident D-brane–anti-D-brane pair, giving zero energy density and restoring spacetime supersymmetry? The paper supplies an argument for an earlier conjecture.

sources.title: Duality and infinite distance limits in asymmetric freely acting orbifolds

evidence.text: How does a free shift reduce the duality group of asymmetric type-IIB orbifolds, and what light towers, supersymmetry enhancements and decompactified theories occur at the additional infinite-distance cusps?

sources.title: Don't panic! Closed string tachyons in ALE space-times

evidence.text: What is the fate of closed-string tachyons localized at noncompact nonsupersymmetric orbifold fixed points, under both worldsheet RG flow and on-shell time evolution? Can their condensation reach flat space or supersymmetric ALE geometries while remaining weakly coupled?

sources.title: On the weak gravity conjecture in string theory with broken supersymmetry

evidence.text: Does the weak gravity conjecture remain compatible with brane interactions at finite radius in perturbative type I string theory when Scherk–Schwarz supersymmetry breaking generates a runaway potential?

sources.title: Gauge Threshold Corrections for Local Orientifolds

evidence.text: When do gauge thresholds in local orientifold models behave as running from the string scale or the bulk winding scale, and how can the string calculation agree with the Kaplunovsky–Louis supergravity expression?

sources.title: On Witten's Instability and Winding Tachyons

evidence.text: Can winding tachyons lower the barrier for Witten's bubble-of-nothing decay, providing a spacetime explanation of Horowitz's conjecture that black strings catalyze Kaluza–Klein vacuum decay?

sources.title: Bootstrapping boundaries and branes

evidence.text: How strongly do annulus open–closed consistency and unitarity constrain conformal boundaries, their tension g and operator spectra, especially stable elementary branes and possible D-brane decays?

sources.title: Stable nonBPS bound states of BPS D-branes

evidence.text: Can the stable non-BPS state predicted by type IIB S-duality on an I4(−1)^FL orbifold five-plane be described through BPS D-string constituents, and can its mass be inferred from the radius at which a charged D-string–anti-D-string pair develops a tachyon?

sources.title: String Phenomenology From a Worldsheet Perspective

evidence.text: Does a GGSO assignment remove every tachyon while retaining three generations and no ordinary supersymmetry? Could a compatible projection also freeze all non-dilaton moduli, preventing access to a tachyonic region by continuous deformations?

sources.title: Weak gravity (and other conjectures) with broken supersymmetry

evidence.text: How does supersymmetry breaking alter gravitational attraction and gauge repulsion for charged branes, and can short-distance attraction coexist with long-range weak-gravity behavior?

sources.title: String Theory Realizations of the Nilpotent Goldstino

evidence.text: Which local string configurations realize a goldstino without bosonic partners, and can the required orientifold planes occur at warped-throat tips?

sources.title: T-duality for non-critical heterotic strings

evidence.text: Determine the global deformation spaces and T-duality groups of full-rank non-critical heterotic strings on a circle, and interpret their symmetry enhancements and dimension-changing tachyon condensation in terms of heterotic branes.

sources.title: Misaligned Supersymmetry and Open Strings

evidence.text: Can misaligned supersymmetry extend to open strings without spacetime supersymmetry, and can cancellations of averaged boson–fermion degeneracies be established beyond leading exponential order?

sources.title: Dark Horse, Dark Matter: Revisiting the $SO$(16)x $SO$(16)' Nonsupersymmetric Model in the LHC and Dark Energy Era

evidence.text: Can a nonsupersymmetric, tachyon-free heterotic model supply an effective framework for visible matter, dark sectors and cosmology? The paper studies this question using a reviewed ten-dimensional SO(16) × SO(16)' construction and mostly low-energy descriptions.

sources.title: A Solution to the Decompactification Problem in Chiral Heterotic Strings

evidence.text: Can chiral heterotic strings with two large dimensions and Scherk–Schwarz supersymmetry breaking avoid gauge thresholds growing linearly with internal volume, so that a Kaluza–Klein scale far below the string scale need not destroy perturbative gauge couplings?

sources.title: Supersymmetry Breaking Warped Throats and the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Can orientifold sectors that break supersymmetry explicitly generate stable throats while their leading large-N geometry appears supersymmetric?

sources.title: String Defects, Supersymmetry and the Swampland

evidence.text: Which string-defect consistency conditions constrain six-dimensional supergravity beyond anomaly cancellation, and how do explicit orientifolds delimit their applicability to BPS defects, stable non-BPS defects and localized supersymmetry breaking?

sources.title: Banks-Zaks stabilisation of non-SUSY strings

evidence.text: Can an accidentally suppressed one-loop string vacuum energy balance a generic two-loop contribution to stabilize the dilaton and geometric moduli at weak coupling, with numerical separation between the AdS and compactification scales?

sources.title: Consistency conditions for branes at orbifold singularities

evidence.text: Which world-sheet tadpole conditions survive the noncompact limit, how do they enforce anomaly freedom on branes, and which extra-tensor phases do orbifold orientifolds construct?

sources.title: Smeared end-of-the-world branes

evidence.text: Can simple tensionful end-of-the-world branes be realized in familiar string/M-theory AdS compactifications while preserving internal rotational symmetry, and are the resulting configurations stable?

sources.title: Bounds on Slow Roll at the Boundary of the Landscape

evidence.text: Does the order-one tachyon bound survive when the unstable mode overlaps the volume of an orientifold-wrapped cycle rather than lying entirely in the universal volume–dilaton sector?

sources.title: Intersecting non-SUSY branes and closed string tachyon condensation

evidence.text: When can a continuous family connecting black Dp-branes to static Kaluza-Klein bubbles represent a physical decay, and can winding closed-string tachyon condensation provide the mechanism and a stable static endpoint?

sources.title: Dynamical tadpoles and Weak Gravity Constraints

evidence.text: How should weak-gravity bounds apply to the evolving backgrounds demanded by dynamical sources? Which alternative probes or constraints can diagnose tadpoles when the regular-instanton WGC test finds a suitable representative?

sources.title: Supersymmetry breaking, brane dynamics and Swampland conjectures

evidence.text: How does string-scale supersymmetry breaking affect static interactions between parallel brane stacks, their agreement across complementary regimes, and their relation to the Weak Gravity Conjecture?

sources.title: Integrability treatment of AdS/CFT orbifolds

evidence.text: How can Abelian AdS/CFT orbifolds be implemented consistently across string boundary conditions, spin chains, TBA and the quantum spectral curve, and can this framework eventually resolve type 0B tachyon stability at intermediate coupling?

sources.title: Gauge Threshold Corrections for Local String Models

evidence.text: How do bulk-volume-dependent gauge thresholds change the apparent unification scale of local brane models, and can they alleviate the tension between intermediate string scales motivated by supersymmetry breaking and the historically inferred supersymmetric unification scale near 10^16 GeV?

sources.title: Exponential suppression of the cosmological constant in nonsupersymmetric string vacua at two loops and beyond

evidence.text: Under what spectrum and charge conditions does the exponentially suppressed one-loop cosmological constant of nonsupersymmetric Scherk–Schwarz heterotic models remain suppressed at two loops, and what might extend to higher orders?

sources.title: Heterotic strings on Enriques surfaces

evidence.text: Which heterotic Enriques orbifold gauge shifts are inequivalent, what light spectra do they produce, and when do their projections remove tachyons inherited from ten-dimensional non-supersymmetric parents?

sources.title: Consistency conditions for orientifolds and D-manifolds

evidence.text: Which Chan–Paton algebra and one-loop divergence conditions constrain orientifolds with D-branes, and what solutions do they permit for Type I on the K3 Z2 orbifold?

sources.title: Brane supersymmetry breaking

evidence.text: Can a perturbative orientifold localize string-scale supersymmetry breaking on selected branes while keeping the bulk and other brane sectors supersymmetric at lowest order, with a chiral tachyon-free explicit example?

sources.title: The Swampland Distance Conjecture and Towers of Tensionless Branes

evidence.text: Which wrapped-brane towers survive an O6 orientifold projection when closed moduli remain freely variable?

sources.title: Modular invariance, finiteness, and misaligned supersymmetry: New constraints on the numbers of physical string states

evidence.text: How do modular invariance and absence of physical tachyons constrain boson–fermion degeneracies without spacetime supersymmetry, and what residual cancellation connects the spectrum to finiteness and allowed supersymmetry breaking?

sources.title: Open strings

evidence.text: How do world-sheet orientifold constructions determine consistent open-string spectra, gauge groups and supersymmetry patterns, and how are these descriptions related to D-branes and O-planes?

sources.title: Closed string tachyons and semiclassical instabilities

evidence.text: Can perturbative closed-string tachyons and semiclassical gravitational instabilities describe the same decay, with bulk tachyon condensation at nonzero coupling ending in spacetime annihilation?

sources.title: Tachyons and Misaligned Supersymmetry in orientifold vacua

evidence.text: Can misaligned supersymmetry and sector averaged spectral growth diagnose physical tachyons in orientifold vacua, where modular transformations exchange loop and tree descriptions rather than preserve each amplitude?

sources.title: On vanishing two loop cosmological constants in nonsupersymmetric strings

evidence.text: Does the two-loop cosmological constant still vanish in two special nonsupersymmetric type II models once coincident picture-changing-operator singularities and potentially finite collision terms are included?

sources.title: Rolling tachyon

evidence.text: Can classical open string field theory, despite infinitely many time derivatives, describe a tachyon displaced from an unstable D-brane's potential maximum through solutions labeled by initial position and velocity? What happens to the brane's energy during this homogeneous decay?

sources.title: Anomalies \& tadpoles

evidence.text: Which massless RR tadpole conditions correspond to anomalies in open and unoriented strings, including sectors invisible to the canonical anomaly polynomial, and how does anomaly factorization determine RR Wess–Zumino couplings?

sources.title: de Sitter in non-supersymmetric string theories: no-go theorems and brane-worlds

evidence.text: These three constructions provide explicit string settings without supersymmetric protection of vacuum energy. Their gravitational tadpoles produce positive dilaton runaways that compete with flux and internal curvature.

sources.title: Global anomalies & bordism of non-supersymmetric strings

evidence.text: Do the three tachyon-free non-supersymmetric ten-dimensional strings have global/Dai–Freed anomalies after local anomaly cancellation, and what can their twisted string bordism groups suggest about branes?

sources.title: Cosmic F and D strings

evidence.text: Under what compactification and brane configurations can macroscopic F-, D-, and wrapped-brane strings survive breakage, tachyon decay, and axion-domain-wall confinement long enough to become observable cosmic strings?

sources.title: Jumping Through Loops: On Soft Terms from Large Volume Compactifications

evidence.text: Do string loop corrections from D-branes and O-planes invalidate large-volume stabilization or its soft supersymmetry-breaking predictions, particularly the suppressed gaugino masses?

sources.title: Quantum Breaking Bound on de Sitter and Swampland

evidence.text: Does a simple stringy unstable extremum relax before its proposed quantum break-time? The example is an attracting D3–anti-D3 pair in a large-radius compactification, with a tachyon emerging when the branes approach within a string length.

sources.title: Vacuum energy cancellation in a nonsupersymmetric string

evidence.text: Can a string vacuum with supersymmetry broken at the string scale have vanishing perturbative cosmological constant, and can the cancellation extend beyond the first two loops?

destinations.title: Does the freely acting, nonsupersymmetric AdS₅×S⁵/Z_k orbifold remain nonperturbatively unstable when large coupling removes its closed-string tachyons, and what does the decay imply for its strongly coupled gauge-theory interpretation?

Can summing closed-string tree diagrams with NS–NS tadpoles recover physical vacuum energies when calculations start from a background that fails the field equations? The paper tests a boundary-state prescription against bosonic tachyon condensation and orientifold examples.
Can tachyon-free, intrinsically nonsupersymmetric heterotic strings suppress dilaton-tadpole instabilities while retaining low-energy spectra resembling the Standard Model or unified extensions?

Can chiral heterotic models with spontaneous N=1→0 supersymmetry breaking develop a positive, exponentially suppressed one-loop potential that drives the breaking scale below the string scale, and which spectral conditions govern this behavior?
Can Scherk–Schwarz compactifications of open string theory have exponentially suppressed or positive one-loop vacuum energy without developing tachyonic Wilson-line moduli?

How do orientifold-compatible brane positions determine the massless spectrum and one-loop vacuum energy after supersymmetry is broken along a circle? The T-dual description makes Wilson lines geometric and separates endpoint half-branes from mirror-paired stacks.

Can a worldsheet construction produce phenomenologically useful non-supersymmetric vacua, and how can their low-energy EFT descriptions be recovered? The paper explores tachyon projection and relations between worldsheet supersymmetry classes as two approaches.
How do gravitational tadpoles affect classical and quantum stability in tachyon-free strings without supersymmetry, and can brane dynamics and holography explain the resulting instabilities?

Can perturbative orientifolds realize brane supersymmetry breaking without NS-NS disk tadpoles or open-string instabilities, while separating open-sector breaking from gravitino masses and testing the proposed obstruction to massless gravitinos?

How do gravitational tadpoles from string-scale supersymmetry breaking affect vacuum solutions, classical and quantum stability, and their interpretation through brane dynamics and swampland conjectures?

Can local, nontrivial cancellation of twisted R-R charges produce BSB orientifolds with fewer brane deformation moduli, and how should their gauge kinetic functions and string-defect unitarity constraints be formulated?

Can heterotic asymmetric orbifolds provide new lower-dimensional analogues of the O(16)×O(16) string: nonsupersymmetric, tree-level tachyon-free models with only the string coupling as a neutral scalar, chiral matter and positive leading vacuum energy?

How do high-mass spectral cancellations diagnose tree-level tachyons, how do tadpole constraints produce rigid six-dimensional orientifolds, and what additional consistency conditions follow from defect unitarity and Dai–Freed anomalies?

Can a nine-dimensional orientifold without background open strings break supersymmetry by compactification, remain continuously connected to type IIB, and admit a nonperturbative S-duality interpretation?

How do tachyons and scalar tadpoles obstruct stable string vacua without spacetime supersymmetry, and what can worldsheet diagnostics, off-shell formulations and gravitational background shifts establish?

Can non-supersymmetric strings cancel gauge/matter one-loop vacuum energy despite string-scale brane supersymmetry breaking, while bulk contributions track large extra dimensions and moduli dynamics generate a dark-energy scale?

How do freely acting, especially asymmetric, type II orbifolds realize spontaneous supersymmetry breaking, constrained moduli spaces and consistent brane spectra, and what do their infinite-distance limits imply for swampland conjectures?

How do asymmetric rotations act on D-branes and implement asymmetric orbifold symmetries in the open-string sector? Can this explain mixed boundary conditions, recover boundary noncommutativity, and construct tadpole-cancelled asymmetric type I vacua?
What do protected N=2 worldsheet RG flows and mirror symmetry imply about closed-string tachyon condensation in compact and noncompact backgrounds, and what probe-theory dualities might follow?

How does open-string tachyon condensation resolve unstable D-branes: what replaces the unstable vacuum, how do lower-dimensional branes emerge, and what does rolling tachyon dynamics imply about closed-string decay and open-string completeness?

Can supersymmetry-breaking modifications of perturbative Type IIB orientifolds produce anomaly-free, nonchiral and chiral large-N gauge theories with cancelled massless and tachyonic tadpoles, and inherit correlation-function reduction to a parent N=4 theory?

Which massless spectra, anomaly cancellations and R-R tadpole conditions make ten-dimensional D9–anti-D9 systems consistent, and does a symplectic orientifold projection yield a tachyon-free nonsupersymmetric USp(32) endpoint?
